name: ai-crypto-advisor
description: Moveo Coding Task - AI Crypto Advisor. Personalized crypto dashboard with AI-generated insights and feedback capture.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
